name: Guldseth Cherry Orchard
description: In Cherry Valley, CA, Guldseth Cherry Orchard raises Apples, Peaches, Nectarines, Apricots, and Plums on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn, summer, and spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
